location.title: Business & location
location.hint: Your address, time zone, currency and hours appear on your website.
location.timeZoneHint: Bookings, orders and opening hours use this time zone.
location.currencyHint: Prices and payments use this currency. Existing prices keep their currency.
location.hoursHint: Shown on your website, e.g. Tue–Sun 8:00–18:00.
location.visible: Visible to customers on your website
location.notVisible: Not visible to customers yet — publish your website to go live

billing.title: Plan
billing.soloBody: One location, hosted website and dashboard, all workflows for your industry.
billing.taxNote: Taxes such as VAT, GST or sales tax are added where they apply. Card and payment fees are charged by your payment provider.

approvals.title: Website approvals
approvals.label: Approve staff changes before they go live
approvals.offHint: Off: you and your managers edit and publish directly.
approvals.onHint: On: changes by staff without approval rights wait for you before they can be published.

upgrade.cardBody: BranchHarbor is set up for one location. Opening another? Upgrade to a network to manage several locations — everything you have now is kept.
upgrade.title: Upgrade to a network
upgrade.intro: {name} is set up as an independent business. A second location needs the network tools. Here is what changes.
consequences: Your existing location, customers, website, team and payment history stay exactly as they are.
The scope selector, Locations directory, regions and owner groups become available.
Website templates can lock fields or require approval, and pages can be published to several locations at once.
Headquarters, regional manager and franchise owner roles can be invited.
Billing moves from the Solo plan to per-location pricing once a second location is operating.
Your customer website gets a location finder at your current address, and each location gets its own page.
upgrade.pricingNote: List prices before tax. A new location isn’t billed until it is operating.
upgrade.codeHint: Short and unique, used in reports and imports.
upgrade.notPublished: The new location starts as a draft: nothing is shown to customers until you publish it.
upgrade.confirm: I understand that this turns my business into a network. My data is kept and the change is recorded in the activity log.
upgrade.ownerOnly: Only the business owner can upgrade. The change is audited.
upgrade.doneTitle: Your business is now a network
upgrade.doneBody: Your locations, regions, templates and group publishing are now available. Your existing data is unchanged.

errors.name: Enter a name for the new location.

website.title: Website
website.description: Edit your website and publish when you’re ready. Changes stay in draft until you publish.
website.published: Published. Your website is live at {address}.
website.approvalsOnStaff: Your changes are sent to the owner for approval before they can be published.
website.noSiteTitle: You don’t have a website yet
website.noSiteBody: Create your hosted website. It uses your business name, address and hours, and you can edit everything before and after publishing.
website.savedDraft: {field} saved as a draft. Publish to make it live.
website.sentToOwner: {field} sent to the owner for approval.
website.noFields: This page has no editable content yet.
website.publishNote: Publishing updates your live website and keeps the previous version for rollback.
website.noPublishPermission: Your role can edit drafts; a manager or the owner publishes.
website.detailsBody: Your website shows the address, opening hours and contact details from Settings.

locationsPage.title: Your location
locationsPage.description: Independent businesses have one location. Its details live in Settings → Business & location.
locationsPage.addDescription: Adding a second location upgrades your business to a network.
locationsPage.noDirectory: There is no locations directory for a single-location business. If you open another location, upgrade below and the network tools appear.
locationsPage.ownerOnly: Ask the business owner to add a location.

roleHelp.org_owner: Full access, including billing, team and business settings.
roleHelp.location_manager: Runs the day: schedules, customers, orders and publishing the website.
roleHelp.staff: Their own schedule, attendance or orders only.
roleHelp.marketing_contributor: Drafts website and marketing content; publishes only if you allow it.

onboarding.businessDesc: Name, address, time zone, currency and hours. This is the one location your customers visit.
onboarding.addressNote: You can change these later in Settings → Business & location. Opening another location later? You can upgrade to a network at any time.
